runs.fullText:
Headline: Good try answering each question, now let’s add detail and cut the fillers.
Strength: Answered every prompt. You gave a response to each coach question. (quote: "Um, yes, I send messages to my, uh, friends.")
Improve: Reduce filler words. Try to pause instead of saying "um", "uh", "you know". (quote: "Um, I use my phone, uh, for, you know, games.") Tip: Practice speaking slowly and count fillers; aim for fewer than 10 per minute.
Improve: Give more complete answers. Add a reason or example when you answer. (quote: "Uh, it goes, like, to the tower. Um, basically that is it.") Tip: After the main idea, say one extra detail, e.g., "It goes to the tower, then travels through cables."
Vocabulary: No major vocabulary issues found. 
Say it better: "Uh, it goes, like, to the tower. Um, basically that is it." -> "It goes to the tower.". Removes filler and unclear phrase.
Say it better: "Um, I use my phone, uh, for, you know, games. And, um, videos. That is all." -> "I use my phone for games and videos.". Clear and concise without fillers.
Reading: You read the whole passage; the app understood 94% of the words at 129 wpm. Went well: Covered the entire passage High accuracy of recognized words Improve: Missed words like "writes" and "cables" (Practice saying those words slowly and clearly.)
Exercise (5 min): Filler word count. Record yourself answering a question, then listen and count how many "um", "uh", "you know" you use. Try to reduce the count by half.
Exercise (7 min): Detail practice. Describe how a text message travels in three sentences, adding one detail for each step.
Next focus: Focus on speaking with fewer filler words and adding more detail to your answers.
